name: vet-med-ppt-team
description: A five-member teaching-PPT engineering team that turns any subject-domain topic into stage-gated, evidence-verified, classroom-ready slide solutions with human-in-the-loop confirmation. The animal-medicine workspace is a test bench, not a product boundary: the workflow is designed to be portable across vocational/tertiary subject domains (animal-medicine today, swinemedicine/pet/aquaculture tomorrow, or any pedagogical subject with adequate evidence base).

displayDescription.en: Five-member team producing evidence-verified, pedagogy-aligned veterinary teaching slide solutions through a stage-gated, human-in-the-loop workflow.
displayDescription.zh: 五人专家团将动物医学教学主题转化为证据核验、教学对齐、可投影授课的完整PPT方案，全程阶段门控确认。
